history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration enhance the first line of monitoring by making more frequent use of accountability indicator monitoring and measure progress in the next cycle of the statement of internal control.
history.administration_response: The Business Transformation and Accountability Division and the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget collaborated to include in the 2023 internal control self-assessment questionnaire a new question as to whether in 2023, the respondent or his/her managers reviewed at least once every quarter the key performance indicator reports available for every delegation of authority key performance indicator in the accountability indicator monitoring section of the management dashboard. In order to provide evidence to entities for responding to the question, MDA has provided the details of the underlining data (extracted from AIM) to the Financial Policy and Internal Controls Service, which were embedded in the self-assessment questionnaire. MDA has also included this question in the “point-in-time” entity profiles, which are prepared every time a briefing with senior managers from entities takes place (including their meeting with the Under Secretary General for Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance), in order to raise the entities’ awareness of this issue. In view of the inclusion of the indicator in the 2023 statement of internal control and the awareness raising through the point-in- time checks, the Administration is requesting the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given the inclusion of the indicator in the 2023 statement of internal control and the awareness- raising through the point- in-time checks, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
